Definition: from G3688; belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a ass):--millstone.
BiblicalUsage: Onikos means belonging to an ass, a millstone, so large it is turned by an ass. Jesus says in Matthew 18:6 and Mark 9:42 that it would be better for a man who offends a little one to have a millstone hung about his neck and be drowned in the depth of the sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the millstone is the measure of offending a child, and Jesus counts the little ones as His own.
